title: Spreadsheet build: extracted receipts to CSV plus validation summary
userStory: As a user, after extracting receipts, Structly builds a clean CSV plus a validation summary (needs-review rows, VAT flags, duplicates) so I can export a verified spreadsheet.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/buildSpreadsheet.js exports buildReceiptSheet(receipts) returning { csv, validation }, where each receipt is an extractReceipt output ({ fields, validation })
csv has a header row (vendor,date,net,vat,gross,category) and one row per receipt, amounts as numbers and dates in ISO format, values properly escaped
validation lists every needs-review row with its reasons and flags duplicates (same vendor+date+gross appearing more than once)
scripts/verify-acceptance.js tests buildReceiptSheet with sample receipts covering a clean set, a needs-review row, and a duplicate pair
npm test passes, dependency-free (no new packages, no network call)
No Google or OAuth dependency is added
